text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness! I don't think I ordered this
much
strawberry mochi...

text_block_list.name: Candy Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry about it! I just put in a
little extra
as a thank-you!

text_block_list.name: Candy Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
...You look like you've been stretched
too thin
lately, Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Well, thank you kindly. I'll savor every
bite.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm. Do I really look that worn out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute is dealing with
some race
fatigue. We might want to
reconsider her race
schedule.
